method: Qualitative independent-role reviews of carving studies and actual printable mesh detail/multiview renders; revisions followed by fresh review
shared_limitations: Closed supported2.5D relief, not full historic undercut carving
White carrier visible obliquely though front projection is hidden
Physical fit, strength and magnetic stability need prototype testing

12-Rocaille-Canted-Octagon.accepted_result: Diagonal octagonal corner structure preserved; visible mechanical pads removed.

13-Rocaille-Segmental-Arch.accepted_result: Floral shoulders, climbing rails and shallow arch preserved; exposed lower socket caps resolved.
13-Rocaille-Segmental-Arch.remaining_limitation: Supported relief and miniature scale simplify fine petals.

14-Rocaille-Cushion-Cartouche.accepted_result: Continuous swelling shoulders and diagonal flowers remain coherent.
14-Rocaille-Cushion-Cartouche.remaining_limitation: Fine petal separation reduced relative to study.

15-Rocaille-Floral-Corners.accepted_result: Distinct flower/leaf corner groups and rectangular sight moulding remain legible.
15-Rocaille-Floral-Corners.remaining_limitation: Upper-right flower partly merges into acanthus.

16-Rocaille-Botanical-Garland.accepted_result: Diagonal bouquets and quieter opposing corners differentiate this rectangle.
16-Rocaille-Botanical-Garland.remaining_limitation: Some neighboring petals merge in the relief.

17-Rocaille-Acanthus-Gallery.accepted_result: Formal center/corner architecture, side flowers and different upper/lower shells remain distinct.
17-Rocaille-Acanthus-Gallery.remaining_limitation: Small floral articulation softer than study.

11-Period-Floral-Portrait-Oval.accepted_result: Approved portrait composition retained; small upper-left exposed mechanical cap replaced locally by continuous folded leaf volume, then accepted by both reviewers.
11-Period-Floral-Portrait-Oval.remaining_limitation: Bowls remain steeper than the study.

18-Rocaille-Landscape-Oval.accepted_result: Independent diagonal landscape composition, quiet upper-right arc, low offset shell and clean ellipse preserved.
18-Rocaille-Landscape-Oval.remaining_limitation: Upper-left cup inner lip is steep; oval aperture masks picture corners.
